description: The worst-rated bridges in a state (condition = Poor), ordered by lowest component rating then age. State is required. Use for 'worst bridges in X' questions. Read-only; no API key. limit defaults to 50 (max 500) and controls how many worst bridges are returned. Use list_posted_or_closed_bridges instead for posted/closed bridges, and search_bridges instead for filtered queries.
name: get_worst_bridges
